executive_assessment.text: The report projects 0.5–1.0°C warming for 2040–2060 versus 1981–2000, with uncertain north–south rainfall differences.
The composite assessment scores 347 of 2,616 collines at very high combined climate, environmental and fragility risk, and none at low or very low risk.

geographic_notes.text: 2,616 collines in Burundi: The composite assessment scores 347 of 2,616 collines at very high combined climate, environmental and fragility risk, and none at low or very low risk.

north Burundi; northwest Burundi; Imbo Plain slope; central plateau: The INDC identifies northern and northwestern vulnerability hotspots and flags the slope toward the Imbo Plain, northern terrain and central plateau as erosion-prone.
